headline: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting

members.title: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting
members.lead: Officials say suspect holds far-right views and three people found dead at his home were his parents and sister Polish prosecutors have opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków, killing six people including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies. Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21. Continue reading...

members.title: Two police officers hailed as heroes for confronting Kraków gunman
members.lead: Jakub Kulik critically injured and Artur Morański also wounded after actions that ‘prevented further casualties’ Two Polish police officers who were injured as they pursued and detained the gunman in Kraków on Saturday have been hailed as heroes. One of them is Jakub Kulik, a former paratrooper and volunteer firefighter, who was left critically injured after a close-range exchange of fire with the suspect, a 24-year-old Polish national who killed six and injured 17 in an attack believed to have been inspired by far-right ideologies. Continue reading...
